5 SECONDS. That’s all Jorge Masvidal needed to create one of the most iconic knockouts in UFC history 😳 Flying knee straight to the face and the entire arena went silent. The buildup, the trash talk, the rivalry… and then BOOM. Fight over before it even started. Ben Askren came in undefeated and confident in his wrestling, but Masvidal had other plans from the very first second. Perfect timing, perfect execution, and one of the coldest walk-off knockouts ever seen inside the Octagon. This wasn’t just a win — it became a legendary MMA moment that fans still talk about years later. The way Masvidal sprinted across the cage with zero hesitation showed he had trained that exact moment over and over. One flying knee changed everything and cemented his name in UFC history forever. Some knockouts are great… this one became iconic. Was this the greatest knockout in UFC history? 👀 #JorgeMasvidal #BenAskren #UFC #MMA #UFCHighlights
